title: Evermyth - God Life Simulator
summary: Become a god. Rule the world. Evermyth is a mythic life sim where you play a god from your very first prayer. Choose your domain, win the faithful, build an island realm, fall in love and face the other gods. Every life is a new myth, and every choice is yours. CHOOSE 1 OF 12 DOMAINS Death, War, Love, Sea, Sky, Nature, Knowledge, Order, Chaos, Craft, Fortune or Hearth. Each plays differently, with its own powers, prayers and stories. Be born to your seat, spring from the world itself, rise from mortal life, or seize the throne from the god before you. CREATE YOUR GOD Shape your face, hair, eyes, crown and robes in hand-drawn art inspired by ancient Greek pottery. Name your cult, choose its sacred sign, and fill a pantheon of twelve with Greek, Roman or Egyptian gods, or invent your own. WIELD 400+ DIVINE POWERS Send the rain. Hurl thunder at the assembly. Curse a king. Raise the dead. Awaken five aspects of your domain and unleash great acts: drown the world in a flood, raise a golden city, or walk among mortals in disguise. ANSWER PRAYERS, SHAPE MORTAL LIVES 400+ prayers, nearly 700 events and 240+ story chains that unfold across years. Shipwrecks, secrets, plagues, weddings, prophecies and family feuds. Every choice has a price, and mortals remember what you did. FACE CALAMITY Locust years, plague ships, great fires, a waking mountain. Save your people, bargain with another god, or let the world burn. WAGE WAR Rival realms want your island. Read your scouts and fight round by round: charge, hold the line, flank, or call down your domain to turn the battle. Sack cities, take tribute or make peace. RAISE A DIVINE BEAST Dragon, kraken, leviathan, hydra, basilisk, great wolf, golden lion, shadow panther, nine-tailed fox, star stag or moon moth. Feed it, train it, fly together, and loose it on your enemies before a hero comes hunting. LOVE, SCHEME AND FEUD Flirt, feast, beguile, trade favors and hold grudges. Marry, raise godborn children, and decide which of them deserves your seat. Win the favor of every court, from the God of the Sky to the smallest river nymph. GODS CAN FALL Rivals and even your own children can challenge you to a contest to the death. Win, and end them the old ways: cast into the pit, chained beneath a mountain, torn apart or swallowed whole. Lose, and your myth may end there. BUILD YOUR REALM Raise temples, markets, harbors, theaters and a Colossus. Keep nobles, priests and commoners on your side, or rule by fear. Change your island's climate, dress your city in your colors, and watch it come alive from dawn to night. GROW YOUR FAITH Turn a handful of believers into ten thousand faithful. Found oracles, ordain a high priest and choose the doctrines of your worship. LIVE A GOD'S OWN LIFE Wander the world as yourself, a mortal or a beast. Visit the Oracle and the Fates, take up pastimes, witness rare wonders, and earn epithets like the Merciful, Godslayer or Ender of Ages. BECOME A LEGEND Pass your seat to an heir and play on as them, or rise to the sky and set yourself among the stars. Every ended myth joins your Hall of Myths. Then begin again as a new god in a new age. PLAY YOUR WAY Free to play with no time limit. Three difficulties, from Gentle to Cruel. Day, evening and night modes. Plays offline, and no accounts, ads, subscriptions, energy timers or currencies.

title: Ground News
summary: Get all your news in one place on an eye-opening platform that shows you the bias, reliability and ownership of every source you read. Cut through the noise and escape media echo chambers with Ground News. Ground News is the largest news aggregator in the world with over 50K news sources and 60K articles added daily. But we aren’t a typical news aggregator, throwing hundreds of headlines at you that barely skim the surface. Ground frees people from algorithmic restraints, illuminates blindspots and makes media bias explicit with our one-of-a-kind media analysis features. AVOID MANIPULATIVE ALGORITHMS SPOT MEDIA BIAS DISCOVER BLINDSPOTS CHECK THE RELIABILITY OF SOURCES SEE WHO OWNS THE NEWS YOU CONSUME Read daily breaking stories from sources around the world, in real time. Like a modern day newspaper, we show you diverse stories instead of algorithm-driven content that can limit your worldview. News coverage is rarely unbiased, so we give you as much context as possible so you can come to your own conclusions. Compare coverage on partisan topics like politics, and elections. Enjoy our free features, or subscribe for in-depth analysis that will transform the way you look at news. About Your Ground News Subscription: Subscriptions renew monthly and can be managed through your App Store account Payment will be charged to your App Store Account on confirmation of purchase Renewal is automatic unless turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period Subscriptions can also be managed through Ground News by going to your Account Settings after purchase See full terms and conditions here: https://ground.news/terms-and-conditions

title: Corner Grocer: Market Sim
summary: Run a little neighborhood market. Order stock, fill the shelves, set your prices, ring up customers at the register, and grow your shop from a corner store into a premium market with a second branch. Corner Grocer is a market management game built to be played with VoiceOver from the very first day. Sighted players and VoiceOver players play the same game with the same rules. A DAY AT THE MARKET • Morning: check deliveries, prices and today's event, then place your orders in the office. • Open: customers come in, ask for help and queue up. Scan their items, take cash or card, and count out the change. • Stock: open crates in the stockroom, put goods on the right shelves and watch the dates. Goods go off, and a wrong shelf sells less. • Evening: read the report, get one clear tip for tomorrow and decide what to invest in. GROW • Start with an empty corner shop and a basket of bread. Earn, then invest: shelves, fridges, freezers, produce stands, bakery cases and deli counters in build mode. • Move up through four store sizes: corner shop, mini market, big market and premium market. • License new product lines. There are 48 products, from bread and milk to hummus, pet food and olive oil. • Open extra registers and hire cashiers. Your own register is always yours. • Much later, open a second branch run by a manager you choose, and read its result in the evening report. • Invest in upgrades, supplier contracts and campaigns. Contracts and campaigns can renew themselves. • In the office, one button fills your order from the suggestions. In the stockroom, one button places every crate that has room. • Daily goals, 22 achievements, and events such as heat waves, rain, power cuts, rival sales and supplier delays. • There is no final day. Play as long as you like. BUILT FOR VOICEOVER • Every station has labelled controls in a fixed order, plus actions for the rotor. Anything you can drag also has a way to do without dragging. • Three speech levels: Full, Balanced and Sounds First. • Magic Tap pauses and resumes the day. • Sound carries information: door chimes, scanner beeps, queue alerts, shelf warnings. The Listening Room in Settings plays every sound and tells you what it means. • Easy, Normal and Custom modes, with assists for patience, day length, customer flow, wrong-shelf protection, undo and clearing spoiled goods each morning. Assists are for everyone and always free. • Short optional small jobs fill the quiet moments at the register. • Customer voices are generated with AI. You can turn them down or off in Settings. MAKE IT YOURS Decorate your shop in the Shop Studio: floors, walls, counters, signs, lights, decor and outfits, plus atmospheres, music albums and end-of-day tunes. Name your shop and let the game describe it to you. FREE TO PLAY, WITH OPTIONAL ADS AND PURCHASES The game is free to download. Cash from the shop pays for stock, shelves and upgrades. Coins are only for sound and looks, and never make the game easier or harder. You can earn Coins by playing and by watching optional ads, or buy Coin packs. Coin packs and support packs are optional in-app purchases. Accessibility features and Easy mode are always free. ADS Ads come from Google AdMob. Optional ads in the evening report and the Shop Studio give 10 Coins each, up to 3 a day. Without VoiceOver, a short full-screen ad can also play between days from day 5. Players using VoiceOver never get forced ads. Any support pack (Starter, Supporter or Founder) removes ads. Ads are personalised only if you allow tracking when the game asks. Play in 11 languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian and Chinese (Simplified). Customers speak all 11 languages. English and Turkish voices come with the app; the others download once while you are online. Questions or feedback: support@birkinapps.com

title: koedesk
summary: koedesk turns your iPhone keyboard into a voice-powered text input. Tap the mic, speak, tap again — your words appear instantly in any app — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Slack, Mail, Notes, anywhere you can type. KEY FEATURES • Universal keyboard Replace the system keyboard. Works in every iOS app — chat with AI agents, draft emails, jot ideas, search the web. No copy-paste needed. • World-class accuracy Powered by ElevenLabs Scribe v2 — ranked #2 of all models on the third-party AA-WER English benchmark (2.2% WER). Accuracy measured and published across 12 languages at koedesk.app/en/benchmark/. • 36 languages, auto-detected Japanese, English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Vietnamese, and more. The keyboard reads your locale settings — no language switching needed. • Built for AI agents Optimized for natural conversation with Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini. Keyterms support lets you feed product names, codebases, and proper nouns for even higher accuracy. Filler words (um, uh) are auto-cleaned. • Custom dictionary Add specialized terms, project names, jargon — koedesk learns and adapts. PRICING • Free — 5 minutes per day, full Scribe v2 quality, no credit card required. • Pro — Unlimited transcription, cancel anytime. PRIVACY FIRST Your audio is processed transiently. We never store voice recordings. Account deletion is one tap away — Settings → Account → Delete Account. WHO IS IT FOR • Developers using AI agents in their workflow • Writers drafting on iPhone • Anyone tired of pecking at the on-screen keyboard • Bilingual users tired of switching between language keyboards Get started free — no credit card, no commitment. Terms of Use — https://koedesk.app/terms/ Privacy Policy — https://koedesk.app/privacy/

title: Everlife 2 - Life Simulator
summary: Build a life. Then build a legacy. Everlife 2 is a free life simulator with no ads and over a million words of story. Grow up, fall in love, chase a career, make a few terrible decisions, and leave a family behind to deal with them. • More than 13,000 cards across school, love, work, family, health, crime and fame • Branching storylines that unfold over years, with multiple endings • 350 jobs, dozens of skills and over 120 kinds of creative projects • 14 towns, each with its own scenery, climate, holiday, stories and elections • Play for generations as your heirs inherit the money, the house and the consequences ONE SEASON AT A TIME Spend each season's energy on your life, your people and your world, then tap Next Season and see what comes back. The Chaos slider runs from quiet suburb to total meltdown, and Classic mode keeps it to one action a season. CREATE SOMEONE. SEE WHO THEY BECOME. Choose their looks, hometown, family, backstory, traits and conditions. Traits come in opposite pairs, like Workaholic and Slacker, and your choices can earn new ones. Your backstory comes back later in life with stories of its own. STORIES THAT REMEMBER One card today can follow you for years. Storylines remember what you chose and how you treated the people in them, then end good, bittersweet, chaotic or secret. GROW UP YOUR WAY Survive grades, cliques, clubs and crushes with the kids from your street. Then apply to college, join Greek life, or skip it and start working. MAKE A LIVING Build a resume, survive the interview and climb ten ranks with pay that matches the real-world job. Answer to a boss, outshine a rival and sweat your yearly review. Or turn to crime. It pays well, until it doesn't. TURN TALENT INTO SOMETHING REAL Master skills to unlock perks, then risk money and time on projects that can fail. Write a novel, record an album, shoot a feature film, design a clothing line or build a personal robot. A hit can pay royalties for years. MONEY IS REAL Track real dollars, net worth and social class. Take out loans, invest, or bid at the auction house. Fall behind and the collectors call. Divorce splits what you own. LOVE, FIGHT, FORGIVE, REPEAT Date, move in, propose, marry, cheat, divorce, reconcile, or let an ex return with excellent timing and terrible intentions. Meet the in-laws, fight for custody, and care for your parents as they age. RAISE A FAMILY Plan a pregnancy, try IVF, hire a surrogate, adopt, or decide parenthood isn't for this life. Watch years of parenting shape the adult your child becomes. Adopt a pet from the shelter too: 21 species and over 100 breeds. MAKE A HOME IN A WORLD THAT MOVES Buy a hometown house or a vacation home in another town, add a recording studio or a pool, and live with a home that's cozy, moldy or haunted. Celebrate eight holidays a year, ride out snow days and heatwaves, and vote for mayor or run yourself. FACE THE HARD YEARS Health problems start as symptoms before they get a name. See a doctor, weigh therapy, medication and insurance, and live with what follows. Injuries, cravings, grief and dementia can reshape a life. So can recovery. EVERY LIFE LEAVES SOMETHING BEHIND When your character dies, read the obituary, hold the funeral and settle the will. Then start over, resurrect, or play on as your heir with the money, heirlooms and unfinished business you left behind. Chase dynasty goals, unlock nearly 200 achievements, and spend Fate to give the next generation a head start. PLAY ON YOUR TERMS Everlife 2 is free and fully offline in 13 languages, with no ads, no wait timers and no premium currency. One life is only the beginning. How will you live your Everlife?

title: Nano Empire 2
summary: Once, nanobots gave humans godlike power to create worlds, limited only by their imagination. But now the Creators have lost control of the creations! You, a humble starship captain, are all that stands between the galaxy and destruction. Nano Empire 2 is an incremental sandbox text adventure, featuring 30 handcrafted worlds where dreams have turned into nightmares. Endless beach parties suddenly have a leviathan problem. Crystal automata rise up against the Queen of Light. A rogue nanobot factory produces strangely beautiful horrors. A royal family of sentient trees has forgotten how to reproduce. There are also vampires, inverted merpeople, and a Great Clown Head. And of course, all these factions are at war... Without nanobots meeting everyone's needs automatically, ship captains like you are about to become the most important people in the galaxy. Transport resources to populations who desperately need them, take sides in wars or profit from both sides, befriend eccentric creatures, grow your fleet, and maybe even research a way to undo the damage. Every world has a dramatically different vision for the future of civilization, and your choices will determine which one is successful. You don't need to have played Nano Empire 1 to enjoy this game, but returning players will notice many recurring characters... -Will Peter Frederick ever grow up and care about something other than partying? -Will Zithguul the giant scorpion escape from the Petting Zoo? -What will happen with Roland, Carla, and the ongoing conflict between the Underworld and the Core?* Features: -100% human-written. No generative AI was used to make this game. -Simple and elegant resource management as in Nano Empire 1. All the storytelling of an open world space opera with none of the tedious inventory management. -30 factions playing out a dynamic simulation of economy, war, and culture. Every action you take affects the balance of power. -Several days of idle gameplay. Each world unlocks new activities over time as it grows. -Collect artifacts and allies with world-shattering effects (sometimes literally). -Over 40 possible endings! (You can experience multiple endings without having to restart the game every time. A handy Ending Tracker is included.) -Play the complete game for free with no ads. An in-app purchase is available to unlock optional worlds and bonus resources. -Fully accessible with VoiceOver. *If you haven't already figured it out, this game takes place after the most interesting ending of Nano Empire: the one with the apocalypse...

title: FruitPot Adventures
summary: A luxury hotel, a missing necklace, and a resourceful detective. Enjoy hours of fun in a free mystery adventure you can play offline, with VoiceOver support. Join James F. Pot as he investigates the Golden Lion Hotel. Talk to its quirky guests, uncover clues, try on disguises, and combine items to solve situations that are as puzzling as they are hilarious. HOURS OF FUN AND CLEVER PUZZLES Explore the hotel and tackle logic, memory, and sound puzzles. Every conversation and every item could help you move forward. Sometimes you’ll need a tool. Sometimes, a disguise. And almost always, a little ingenuity. PLAY OFFLINE, AT YOUR OWN PACE Play without an internet connection and take your investigation wherever you go. Automatic saving keeps your progress safe, and three save slots let you organize your adventures. ACCESSIBILITY THAT LETS YOU EXPLORE YOUR WAY • VoiceOver support. • Descriptions of scenes, objects, and characters. • Guided controls to browse, select, and describe elements around you. • Customizable voice narration. • Separate volume controls for music, ambient sounds, voices, and sound effects. • Options for larger buttons and more vivid colors. • Map zoom to explore the details. • Reduced animation and outlines for interactive areas. FOR IPHONE AND IPAD Enjoy retro-style scenery, music, and memorable characters, with text in English, Spanish, French, German and Italian. THE COMPLETE GAME IS FREE No ads and no payments required to continue the story. You can finish the entire adventure for free. If you’d like to support future adventures, you’ll find four optional contribution levels under the star on the main menu. Each level unlocks a supporter emblem, without gameplay advantages or content needed to finish the adventure. Contributions require an internet connection to the App Store. There’s a mystery waiting at the Golden Lion. James F. Pot has just arrived.

title: Sonnounce
summary: Send announcements to the Sonos speakers in your house – in your own voice. Pick the speakers you want, hold the button down while you talk, and let go. The announcement plays right away. While the announcement plays, the music is turned down, and afterwards it comes back up. The announcement itself plays at the volume the speaker is already set to. NO ACCOUNT. NO CLOUD. NO SUBSCRIPTION. The app talks directly to the speakers on your own network. The sound is recorded on the phone, and the speaker fetches it from there. Your voice never leaves the house. An announcement can be up to five minutes long. FROM YOUR WRIST With Apple Watch you can record an announcement straight from your wrist. The watch passes it on through your iPhone. SHORTCUTS Type a text in Shortcuts, and the phone reads it aloud on your speakers. It is read aloud in the language the app is set to. Use it in automations, for example when dinner is ready or when someone rings the doorbell. You can also have the most recent announcement repeated. AWAY FROM HOME With a Homey Pro you can send announcements home even when you are out. This requires the Sonnounce app to be installed on your Homey as well. If you have a VPN to your home, you can also send announcements that way. SAVE THE ANNOUNCEMENTS With a Homey you can save every announcement sent in the house. They are kept on your own Homey at home – not in the cloud – and you can download them to your iPhone. Requires Sonos speakers on the same Wi-Fi as the phone.

title: My Little Window
summary: Grow a tiny garden on a sunlit windowsill. Plant a seed, watch it sprout in real time, and come back to a bloom. No ads, ever. My Little Window is a gentle idle garden that grows even while the app is closed. There is no failure here. Nothing withers, nothing rushes you, and every plant is happy to wait. GROW IN REAL TIME Seeds mature on their own schedule, from a one minute pothos to a full day jade. Water them, mist them, give them sun. Well tended plants sell for more. COLLECT THEM ALL Every home has twenty species for your Plant Book, 240 in all, and every one hides a rare variant with its own look. Open seed packs, chase rares, and cross-breed two seeds for a chance at something special. A JOURNEY OF LITTLE HOMES Complete a home to travel down the path to the next: twelve homes across four chapters, each with its own window, its own plants and its own rooms. • The Meadow: a woodland cabin, a suburban flower garden and a farmhouse kitchen garden. • Warm Shores: a beach cottage, a harbor and a lighthouse, where messages in bottles wash up on your sill. • Country Lanes: an English cottage garden, a prairie homestead and a hillside burrow, where bees visit your blooms and leave new seeds. • Sun & Stone: a Tuscan vineyard house, a Moroccan riad and a desert adobe, where every bloom you sell becomes a tile for a mosaic wall. More homes are on the way. MAKE IT YOURS Coins from your blooms furnish five cozy rooms in every home. Every armchair, shelf, and lamp gives your garden a lasting boost, from faster growth to luckier packs. A LIVING WINDOW Morning light, golden hour, starry nights, and quiet rain move across your window through the day. Animal friends wander by. A daily gift waits each morning, and streaks make it sweeter. KIND BY DESIGN No ads. No energy bars. No pressure. Gems can speed things up, but everything in the game can be earned for free. Pull up a chair by the window. Your garden is already growing.

title: Treblo - AI Music
summary: Make songs with the world's best AI music model. For free. No limits. Turn any idea into a real song—a meme for the group chat, a love song for your person, or a track the whole world vibes to. Whatever you hear in your head, Treblo helps you make it. CREATE IN SECONDS Describe your song. Pick a style. Hit generate. That's it. Want more control? Tweak lyrics, tags, and settings whenever you want. MAKE IT YOURS Extend tracks. Swap sections. Upload audio to cover. Craft until it's perfect. SHARE & DISCOVER Post your music. Follow other artists. Join groups. Remix what inspires you. Build your audience. Hyperpop. Drift phonk. Sea shanties. If you can imagine it, you can create it. Privacy Policy: https://treblo.com/privacy Terms of Service: https://treblo.com/tos
